business_name: Exact Legal/Trading Name — copy character for character
owner_name: First name if known — used in the email greeting
sector: Tours & Watersports | Guesthouse / Rental | Restaurant / Bar | Food Truck | Trades / Contractor | Auto / Car Rental | Professional Services | Health / Clinic | Retail / Boutique | Salon / Barber | Gym / Fitness | Events / Wedding

identity._comment: THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT BLOCK. Fill it by actually looking at their Instagram grid and Facebook photos. Vague answers here produce generic sites.
identity.mood: e.g. 'weathered beach shack, hand-painted signs, plastic chairs, family-run, unhurried'
identity.palette_source: e.g. 'faded turquoise on their door, warm sand, the orange of their fish tacos'
identity.type_feel: e.g. 'hand-painted sign lettering -> warm humanist serif' or 'chrome logo -> clean geometric sans'
identity.voice: e.g. 'short, playful, lots of exclamation marks, mixes English and Papiamento'
identity.proudest_of: What do they post about most? This becomes the hero.

photos.alt: Describe exactly what is in the photo

offering._comment: ONLY real information. If you do not have it, leave it empty and it will be omitted from the site. Never invent prices.

the_hook._comment: The specific, verifiable reason this business is losing money right now. Goes in the email.
the_hook.observed_problem: e.g. 'menu only exists as a Facebook photo from 2023'
